Fairlead 1.2.1 makes Connected honest, fixes domain Direct with Chrome, and stabilizes QUIC / bypass routing on both platforms.

## Both platforms

- **Connected** only when the system path actually uses the tunnel — not when an internal HTTP delay probe succeeds
- Domain Direct works with Chrome Secure DNS (DoH) via sniffer
- Host and domain rules apply before app process rules
- IPv6 on the TUN only when the WireGuard config includes an IPv6 address
- Applying Direct / Through or Block QUIC restarts the engine so routes stay honest
- Status shows **Updating routes…** while rules are applied
- Reachability keeps the last good ICMP ping instead of dropping to blank on a missed sample

## macOS

- Path readiness checks the system route into the mihomo utun
- Closing connections no longer posts `network_change` (could bounce browsers onto the physical interface)

## Windows

- Path readiness checks the best route into Meta / Wintun
- Bypass / QUIC updates correctly move the UI to Connecting with **Updating routes…**
